service.description: The current user's Today (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.get#UserTodayItems with the today-source providers of the shell data) as the screens show it: the day, the groups in order (Overdue, Due today, Later today, then one per source) with each item decorated (icon by kind, the link of the item and of its record through ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink, the time or "overdue since", the other assignees, and which quick actions apply), the sources that failed, the approvals waiting and the counts. A failing source is in failedSources and the rest is shown (failure tolerance).

parameter.name: sourceServiceNames
parameter.description: The today-source providers: maps of service and label, or names

parameter.name: counts
parameter.description: overdue, dueToday, laterToday, eventsToday, sourceItems, total

service.description: Whether the current user may change a task or activity from Today (Mark done, Reschedule): a WetTask of which the user's party is the owner or a current Assignee (not declined or unassigned), as get#UserTodayItems decides canUpdate; never a production run's operation (impl-manufacturing F38) or managed maintenance work (MANAGED_WORK, impl-maintenance P3). An error otherwise.
Mark done: a task or activity of the user to WeComplete (mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task).

Reschedule: a new due date for a task or activity of the user (mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task estimatedCompletionDate); the time of day of the old due date is kept when the new one is a date only.

The Today panel's quick-add line: a task due today (at the end of the day), assigned to the user, on the record of the screen context when one is given (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.link#WorkEffortRecord).

The rows of org.moqui.ui.NotificationServices.get#UserNotifications as the lists show them: the reason's icon and label, the app's title (appTitles, from the shell data), when it came ("5 min ago", "Yesterday 3:12 PM", "Oct 12"), whether it is unread, an approval's summary, and the link a row opens: the record's BOSS screen (ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink) for a notification on a record or for a Mantle record-update topic, except an approval topic's, which opens its own screen link first when it has one (impl-maintenance P16 review), else its own link (one through Commons' openRecord resolved here the same way). openIsScreen is true for a /qapps or /apps link, which opens in the canvas.

Open a notification of the current user: marks it viewed (org.moqui.ui.NotificationServices mark#NotificationsViewed) and answers where to go, screenUrl for a screen of the shell or redirectUrl for another link. A notification whose record is gone, or with no link, goes to the Notifications center with a message.

parameter.name: notice
parameter.description: Why it opens the center instead of its link

service.description: Mark all read, of one inbox: the current user's unread notifications of NinNotifications or NinUpdates, leaving the approvals waiting as they are (an approval leaves the list by its decision, not by being read; the framework's mark#NotificationsViewed with an inbox would mark them too).
Mark read: the given notifications of the current user (a list, or comma separated as a list's row selection posts them).

actions.script: const ids = (Array.isArray(notificationMessageId) ? notificationMessageId : String(notificationMessageId).split(',')) .map((id) => String(id).trim()).filter((id) => id) viewedCount = ids.length ? (ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.ui.NotificationServices.mark#NotificationsViewed') .parameters({notificationMessageIdList: ids}).call()?.viewedCount || 0) : 0

service.description: Bulk approve: org.moqui.ui.NotificationServices.approve#NotificationMessage for each notification given (a list, or comma separated), each on its own: one that fails is logged and named, the others are approved.

The notification topics the user can set, for Commons/Settings/Notifications: the topics that are not private, the notification-topic providers of the apps the user may open (providerTopics, from the shell data) and those the user has a setting for, each with the user's in-app, email and daily digest values (NotificationTopicUser, else the topic's defaults) and by inbox (an approval topic is always in Notifications).
The current user's setting for a notification topic (NotificationTopicUser): in app, email and daily digest, each Y or N (anything else is N).

The key bindings for Commons/Settings/Preferences: the shell's own (the palette, close, the key help, quick create) and the keymap providers of the apps the user may open (keymaps, from the shell data), each with its scope, id (the binding's action, else its keys, as the KEYMAP preference names it), label, default keys and the keys in effect with the user's KEYMAP overrides.

parameter.name: keymaps
parameter.description: The keymaps of the shell data's apps, each with its appTitle

service.description: Changes one key binding in the current user's KEYMAP preference (JSON {scope: {id: keys}}, which the shell reads when a page loads); empty keys, or the default keys, take the override away.

The Appearance preferences of the current user: dark mode (QUASAR_DARK) and the left drawer (QUASAR_LEFT_OPEN), which the shell reads when a page loads, and the density (SHELL_DENSITY) and the start app (SHELL_START_APP), kept for the shell (design-drawers-commons.md §11).

actions.script: ec.user.setPreference('QUASAR_DARK', darkMode === 'Y' || darkMode === 'true' ? 'true' : 'false') ec.user.setPreference('QUASAR_LEFT_OPEN', leftOpen === 'Y' || leftOpen === 'true' ? 'true' : 'false') ec.user.setPreference('SHELL_DENSITY', density === 'compact' ? 'compact' : 'comfortable') ec.user.setPreference('SHELL_START_APP', startApp ? String(startApp) : '')

service.description: The first-run card of Commons Home: add a mail account, import contacts, connect a calendar and install on your phone, each with its state from the COMMONS_SETUP preference (JSON {item: done or dismissed}); showCard while one is neither.
Done or Dismiss on an item of the first-run card (COMMONS_SETUP); an empty state shows it again.

The user's photo, the face image of their own party (never another's: the party is the user account's): a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file of at most 5 MB, stored by mantle.party.PartyServices.create#PartyContent as PcntFaceImage. It takes the place of the photo before, whose rows and files are removed (remove#MyPhoto keepPartyContentId).

Removes the user's photo: the PcntFaceImage PartyContent rows of the user's own party, and their files under the party's content folder (a file that cannot be deleted is logged; its row is gone), but keepPartyContentId (the photo just uploaded). The initials show in its place.
The location of the user's photo (the latest PcntFaceImage of their party), null without one.

actions.script: contentLocation = null partyContentId = null const partyId = ec.user.userAccount?.partyId if (!partyId) return const rows = ec.entity.find('mantle.party.PartyContent').condition('partyId', partyId).condition('partyContentTypeEnumId', 'PcntFaceImage') .orderBy('-contentDate,-partyContentId').limit(1).list() if (!rows.length) return contentLocation = rows[0].contentLocation || null partyContentId = rows[0].partyContentId

service.description: The face image of a user account's own party (the latest PcntFaceImage), for m-avatar given only a user id (the header, and any avatar that does not already pass an image). Null when that user has no account, no party or no photo. A signed-in user may see another user's photo: it is the picture shown beside their name.

actions.script: contentLocation = null partyContentId = null const account = ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAccount').condition('userId', String(userId)).useCache(true).one() const partyId = account?.partyId if (!partyId) return const rows = ec.entity.find('mantle.party.PartyContent').condition('partyId', partyId).condition('partyContentTypeEnumId', 'PcntFaceImage') .orderBy('-contentDate,-partyContentId').limit(1).list() if (!rows.length) return contentLocation = rows[0].contentLocation || null partyContentId = rows[0].partyContentId
